description.mekwasher.bulk_washer: Washes items just like Create's Bulk Washing (a fan blowing through water), but in a single block. Pipe water into the top or right-click it with a water bucket, and power it like any other Mekanism machine. Supports Speed and Energy upgrades.
description.mekwasher.electric_deployer: Does what Create's Deployer does to items on a belt or depot, in a single block: applies the held item (top slot) onto the processed item (bottom slot). Handles deploying, item application, sandpaper polishing and the deploying steps of Sequenced Assembly. Supports Speed and Energy upgrades.
